thread:
Clare (CS): Heads-up: Cedar Labs QBR Thurs 9am PT. Asks: token runway slide, two commit scenarios with clear $ math, onboarding blockers, and a single-line renewal ask. Can @Devon - FinOps take econ?

Devon - FinOps: I can own econ. Preference: show last 30d daily + rolling 90d trend. Also include a per-route top 6 table and a simple CSV attached.

usage-bot: ALERT: cedar-labs crossed 78% of monthly commit yesterday. Details: https://billing.redwood.example/accounts/cedar-labs/usage

Marta (SE): Onboarding status: ingestion resumed but we saw repeated retry storms during a bulk import yesterday which inflated token count. Root cause = connector backoff misconfig and their consumer producing duplicate messages. I patched the connector to apply idempotency keys in staging; prod patch awaiting their infra change.

Jonas (CSM): Customer feedback to capture: they want a short justification memo for any commit increase, clearer per-route token telemetry, and a 30-day pilot for burst credits. Also asked if quantized models will preserve strict JSON schemas.

Devon - FinOps: Draft sims (pre-verify): last 30d tokens = 52,300,000; projected month = ~58.2M if current pace continues. Projected overage (no throttles) = ~8.2M tokens -> est $1,820 at today's unit rates.

Devon - FinOps: SQL used to fetch daily usage:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer_id = 'cedar-labs' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```

Devon - FinOps: Scenario sketches I'll prepare for the slide:
- Scenario A (status quo): no commit change, pay-on-demand. 
- Scenario B (conservative): +15% commit -> 66.8M commitment; expected invoice = $12.4k/mo; fewer throttles.
- Scenario C (aggressive + quant): +35% commit -> 78.6M commit; invoice = $14.3k/mo, if they adopt "q3-small-quant" unit cost could fall ~20% -> effective spend ~ $11.4k/mo and lower variance. Latency delta estimate for q3-small-quant: +8-12ms median.

Marta (SE): I tested q3-small-quant on their structured responses. Most schemas held, but two strict parsers failed due to minor whitespace/float formatting. Recommend we include a "templating tolerance" note and list affected routes.

Jonas (CSM): I'll capture an exact customer quote for the commit ask. Proposed 1-line renewal ask draft: "Increase commit to 78.6M tokens/month for 12 months; Redwood to provide a 30-day burst cushion pilot and quarterly cost reviews." Thoughts?

Clare (CS): Nice. One more ask: can we show a quick delta comparing throttled vs. unthrottled ingestion impact on token burn last 30d? That helps justify commit vs throttle tradeoffs.

Devon - FinOps: Good idea. I'll compute daily burn with current throttle schedule vs. simulated no-throttle baseline and export both as CSV. Command I used to grab raw CSV:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://billing-api.redwood.internal/accounts/cedar-labs/usage?window=30d&format=csv" -o cedar-30d.csv
```

Devon - FinOps: Quick interim numbers for the slide: 30d observed = 52.3M, 30d simulated no-throttle = 56.7M (delta = 4.4M tokens). If those 4.4M had not been throttled they'd have cost an additional ~$970.

Marta (SE): I'll attach a short log snippet showing the retry burst and the idempotency fix we validated in staging. ETA for prod infra sign-off: Mon 2pm PT.

Jonas (CSM): I'll coordinate with Sales for a potential 12mo incentive if they sign the higher commit by EOM. Also will confirm the customer's acceptance of the burst pilot.

Clare (CS): Owners recap: Devon - FinOps (charts, commit sims, throttle vs baseline CSV, alerts), Marta (SE) (integration notes, logs, templating risk), Jonas (CSM) (customer quote, sales handoff), Clare (CS) (deck + runbook).

Devon - FinOps: I'll also set 80% and 95% alerts and propose an auto-throttle schedule: at 80% -> gentle 30% ingest rate reduction; at 95% -> stricter 60% ingest reduction and notify CSM/CS. Will post links to alerts in /drive/cedar/qbr.

usage-bot: SCHEDULED ALERT: cedar-labs threshold=80% will auto-notify at 2025-08-01T09:15:00Z unless commit updated.

Marta (SE): Will freeze connector auto-retries until post-QBR prep window. ETA for final prod patch confirmation Mon 14:00 PT.

Jonas (CSM): Ping me when alerts exist and when the commit-slide draft is ready; I'll polish the one-line ask and capture the customer's quote.

Clare (CS): Reconvene Mon 5pm PT for final slide pass. If blockers pop up DM me. :white_check_mark:
